description.value:
Duration constant

A Failure Point you have named continues to degrade on its own. Each hour that passes, the DC to bring about that failure decreases by 1, to a minimum of 10 below the DC the GM first gave you. This continues whether or not you are present, whether or not you remember it, and whether or not anyone is working on it. Repairing the target ends it.

cinderfall.incomplete: THE FAILURE POINT's DC degrades hourly on its own -- an info-only mechanic being given an auto-decrementing DC, which has no counter mechanism (NOSTACK-adjacent).
